definitions.explanation: The second-highest administrative position at a school, directly below the principal. Responsible for assisting the principal with school management and often handling day-to-day operations.

examples.japanese: {教頭|きょうとう}{先生|せんせい}に{呼|よ}ばれた。
examples.english: I was called by the vice-principal.

examples.japanese: {教頭|きょうとう}が{校長|こうちょう}の{代|か}わりに{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: The vice-principal gave a greeting in place of the principal.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}から{教頭|きょうとう}に{昇進|しょうしん}することが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: It's been decided that I'll be promoted to vice-principal starting next year.

notes:
USAGE:
{教頭|きょうとう} is addressed as {教頭|きょうとう}{先生|せんせい} by students and staff. The role involves managing school schedules, supervising teachers, and handling administrative tasks that the {校長|こうちょう} (principal) delegates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教頭|きょうとう}{先生|せんせい} (vice-principal — polite address)
- {教頭|きょうとう}に{昇進|しょうしん}する (to be promoted to vice-principal)
- {副|ふく}{校長|こうちょう} (vice-principal — alternative title used in some schools)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{副|ふく}{校長|こうちょう} is an alternative title for the same position, used in some school systems. In schools that have both, {副|ふく}{校長|こうちょう} may outrank {教頭|きょうとう}.
